Mouana Serenity Cherng Talay

Villa in Cherng Talay
HomeNew ProjectsMouana Serenity Cherng Talay

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A development of single-storey private pool villas in Cherng Talay, on generous plots with large built-up areas. The agent lists 3 and 4 bedroom villas, with Boat Avenue, Porto de Phuket, Laguna Golf and Blue Tree among the nearby attractions.

Facilities & amenities

  • 24/7 security and monitoring
  • Covered parking
  • CCTV
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Swimming pool with poolside facilities
